description: A progressive TypeScript framework for Node.js backends: from a small API in one file to efficient, scalable, enterprise-grade systems 🚀

latest_release.body:
## v12.5.1 (2026-11-16)

#### Features
* `core`
  * [#18523](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18523) feat(core): accept module metadata as the root module ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))

#### Bug fixes
* `common`
  * [#18515](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18515) fix(common): reject a date past the end of its month in parse date pipe ([@jaeminbird](https://github.com/jaeminbird))
* `microservices`
  * [#18521](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18521) fix(microservices): decode each value of a repeated kafka header ([@yuvrajtiwary-bitmesraece](https://github.com/yuvrajtiwary-bitmesraece))
  * [#18512](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18512) fix(microservices): stop a kafka connection attempt once the client is closed ([@BillWGong](https://github.com/BillWGong))
* `platform-node`
  * [#18509](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18509) fix(node): render nunjucks views through an Environment ([@xh123637](https://github.com/xh123637))

#### Enhancements
* `microservices`
  * [#18525](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18525) feat(microservices): graceful shutdown for the rmq server ([@samuelmbabhazi](https://github.com/samuelmbabhazi))
  * [#18514](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18514) feat(microservices): graceful shutdown for the tcp server ([@samuelmbabhazi](https://github.com/samuelmbabhazi))
  * [#18513](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18513) feat(microservices): graceful shutdown for the mqtt server ([@samuelmbabhazi](https://github.com/samuelmbabhazi))
  * [#18505](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18505) feat(microservices): graceful shutdown for the redis and nats servers ([@samuelmbabhazi](https://github.com/samuelmbabhazi))

#### Docs
* `common`
  * [#18508](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18508) docs(common): correct the default breakLength of the console logger ([@ragib-mrb](https://github.com/ragib-mrb))
* `common`, `core`, `microservices`, `platform-express`, `platform-fastify`, `platform-node`, `platform-socket.io`, `platform-ws`, `testing`, `websockets`
  * [#18503](https://github.com/nestjs/nest/pull/18503) docs: use absolute links for the translated guides and license ([@abd1rahmane](https://github.com/abd1rahmane))

#### Committers: 8
- Abderrahmane Messaadi ([@abd1rahmane](https://github.com/abd1rahmane))
- BillW Gong ([@BillWGong](https://github.com/BillWGong))
- Jae Birdsall ([@jaeminbird](https://github.com/jaeminbird))
- Kamil Mysliwiec ([@kamilmysliwiec](https://github.com/kamilmysliwiec))
- Ragib MRB ([@ragib-mrb](https://github.com/ragib-mrb))
- Yuvraj Tiwary ([@yuvrajtiwary-bitmesraece](https://github.com/yuvrajtiwary-bitmesraece))
- [@xh123637](https://github.com/xh123637)
- samuel mbabhazi ([@samuelmbabhazi](https://github.com/samuelmbabhazi))
